title: Payment Timing and Guarantee by Rate Plan (Room Reservations)
content:
Under Room Reservations, every rate plan fixes when the stay is paid, how much of it is charged at booking, how many nights a resort advance deposit covers, whether a deposit comes back on a timely cancellation, and the guarantee the reservation carries at booking before any resort deposit rule applies.

| Rate plan | When the stay is paid | Share of the stay's room and tax charged at booking | Resort deposit nights | Deposit refunded on a cancellation on or before the deadline | Guarantee recorded at booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate | Prepaid at booking | 100% | 0 | No | Full prepayment |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 1 | Yes | Credit card |
| Flexible Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 1 | Yes | Credit card |
| Member Flexible Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 1 | Yes | Credit card |
| Bed & Breakfast Package Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 1 | Yes | Credit card |
| Corporate Negotiated Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 0 | Yes | Credit card |
| Group Block Rate | Paid at the hotel | 0% | 0 | Yes | Credit card |
| Reward Night Rate | Redeemed at booking | 0% | 0 | Yes | Reward redemption |

## Terms used in the table

- **When the stay is paid** takes one of three values: prepaid at booking, paid at the hotel, or redeemed at booking.
- **Share of the stay's room and tax charged at booking** is the percentage of the total room and tax of the stay charged to the card at booking.
- **Resort deposit nights** is the number of nights of room and tax collected as an advance deposit at booking when the hotel's brand is Ashbury Resort & Spa or Ashbury Reserve, in whole nights.
- **Deposit refunded on a cancellation on or before the deadline** states whether an advance deposit is refunded when the reservation is cancelled on or before the effective cancellation deadline.
- **Guarantee recorded at booking** is the guarantee the reservation carries at booking before any resort deposit rule applies.

## Points of reading

- The Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate is the only plan charged in full at booking (100% of room and tax) and the only plan whose deposit is not refunded on a cancellation on or before the deadline.
- A resort deposit of 1 night exists only on the Semi-Flexible Saver, Flexible, Member Flexible and Bed & Breakfast Package Rates; the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable, Corporate Negotiated, Group Block and Reward Night Rates show 0 resort deposit nights.
- The Reward Night Rate is redeemed at booking and is guaranteed by the reward redemption.
